polls.description: New York becomes the first US state to halt all new data center construction, marking a historic regulatory response to AI infrastructure expansion.
polls.question: Should New York's data center moratorium be a model for other states?

cluster_stories.title: New York, a state without nearly any data centers, becomes first to ban their construction
cluster_stories.summary: No hyperscale facilities have landed in New York yet — but Hochul signed a moratorium anyway, with her reelection and the state's utility bills on the line.
cluster_stories.headline: NEW YORK BANS DATA CENTER CONSTRUCTION

cluster_stories.title: New York State halts construction of all new data centers
cluster_stories.summary: New York has become the first state to temporarily halt approval of large data centers, as Gov. Kathy Hochul argues the AI-driven building boom shouldn’t come at the expense of higher electricity costs, water supplies, or local control.
cluster_stories.headline: NEW YORK HALTS ALL DATA CENTER CONSTRUCTION... First State to Block AI Building Boom

cluster_stories.title: New York Governor Signs First Statewide Data Center Moratorium
cluster_stories.summary: “We have no choice but to address the challenges created by these massive facilities,” New York governor Kathy Hochul said. The executive order will pause construction for one year.
cluster_stories.headline: HISTORIC: New York Signs First Statewide Data Center Moratorium

cluster_stories.title: New York becomes first state to impose one-year pause on new AI datacenters
cluster_stories.summary: Governor Kathy Hochul issues executive order enacting a moratorium on the large, resource-intensive AI facilitiesNew York became the first US state to enact a moratorium on new datacenters on Tuesday.Governor Kathy Hochul issued an executive order mandating a one-year statewide pause on the large facilities used to power artificial intelligence products, which she signed at a mid-morning press conference. cluster_stories.title: 29 countries sign a treaty to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization
cluster_stories.summary: Twenty-nine countries signed an agreement on 16 July to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization (WAICO), Reuters reported. China says the intergovernmental body aims to promote international cooperation and global governance in AI. China’s foreign minister, Wang Yi, signed on behalf of Beijing. UN Secretary-General António Guterres attended the ceremony. The founding members include Russia, […] This story continues at The Next Web

cluster_stories.title: Chinese filing implies DeepSeek valuation of around $52 billion
cluster_stories.summary: The stock-exchange filing offers rare public evidence about the pricing and investor lineup of DeepSeek's maiden external fundraising, which the company has never announced. As a private company, DeepSeek ‌has no routine ⁠disclosure ⁠obligations.

cluster_stories.summary: Chinese AI pioneer DeepSeek is considering raising more funds weeks after closing a $7 billion round of financing, the Financial Times reported, citing people with knowledge of the deal.

cluster_stories.title: China's DeepSeek considers new fundraising after first round
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is considering another funding round. This comes just one month after closing its initial financing. The company seeks a valuation of approximately seventy-one billion dollars. DeepSeek recently raised seven billion dollars at a fifty-two billion dollar valuation. The startup is also developing its own AI chip.
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK HUNTS NEW FUNDING AT $71B... ONE MONTH AFTER $7B ROUND
